Foundation Panel 的稳定性更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A stability update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 修复 WebView2 渲染或浏览器进程退出后窗口一直空白的问题，面板现可自动恢复。
  Fixes a blank window after a WebView2 renderer or browser process exits; the panel now recovers by itself.
- 修复偶发的栈溢出崩溃。
  Fixes occasional stack-overflow crashes.
- 修复在中文环境检查更新时崩溃的问题。
  Fixes a crash when checking for updates on the Chinese release page.
- 无法获取预发布信息时，检查更新如实提示，不再显示「已是最新」；当前为预发布版本且没有更新版本时会明确说明。
  When prerelease information cannot be fetched, the update check says so instead of "up to date"; a prerelease install with nothing newer is stated plainly.
- 选择 Mirror酱 更新却改用其他来源下载时，会说明原因（例如 Mirror酱 尚未同步该版本）。
  When an update comes from another source than the chosen Mirror酱, the reason is stated (for example, Mirror酱 has not synced that version yet).
- 修复手动检查已是最新后，概览仍显示有可用更新的问题；读不到当前版本时不再误报更新。
  Fixes the overview still showing an available update after a manual check said up to date; an unreadable installed version no longer reports an update.
- 修复标题栏按钮之间的空隙无法拖动窗口。
  Fixes the gaps between title-bar buttons not dragging the window.
- 崩溃报告可附带已匿名处理的运行日志（可在设置中关闭错误报告）。
  Crash reports can include an anonymised session log (error reports can be turned off in the settings).
- 许可证统一为 MIT；foundation-ui 为 MPL-2.0。
  Licensing is MIT throughout; foundation-ui is MPL-2.0.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
